title: SemiAgency City
tagline: Every building is one thing the SemiAgency suite does. Walk in, read the sign, copy what you need.

districts.name: Meeting Quarter
districts.subtitle: You just came out of a meeting. Discovery2Presentation turns it into a proposal, a deck or a record — with you at every gate.

districts.name: M365 Harbour
districts.subtitle: Inside the Microsoft 365 tenant: scheduled prompts, Power Automate flows and Agent Builder agents. No local machine needed.

districts.name: The Lab
districts.subtitle: Tools for people who want to know, not guess.

districts.name: New Arrivals
districts.subtitle: Features found in the repo that nobody has placed on the map yet. Add them to city/city.json.

buildings.name: Radio Tower
buildings.pitch: The daily brief: a scheduled prompt in Copilot Chat that reads your calendar, inbox and tasks every weekday morning. Ten minutes to set up, then it just appears.

buildings.name: Harbour Office
buildings.pitch: Meeting filing, automatic: when a Teams transcript lands, a Power Automate flow creates the meeting's folder in SharePoint, a OneNote page and pings you in Teams. Standard connectors only.

buildings.name: Lighthouse
buildings.pitch: Evening prep: at 18:00 a scheduled prompt looks at tomorrow's meetings, summarises the last ones from the library, lists open actions and proposes an agenda.

buildings.name: The Library
buildings.pitch: Meeting Summariser, an Agent Builder agent over the Meetings library: same-day summary, 1-1 prep, what is open from the last two weeks. On demand, one click.

buildings.name: Post Office
buildings.pitch: Email Drafter: rough text and a recipient in, subject line and a ready-to-send body in your own voice out. Learns the voice from rules you write once and 15–20 of your sent mails.

buildings.name: Clock Tower
buildings.pitch: 1-1 agenda check: the day before a recurring 1-1, a flow pings you if the invite has no agenda. It never writes one and never cancels — that is your call.

buildings.name: The Embassy
buildings.pitch: Fit Finder, an agent shared with colleagues: describe an AI idea you saw and your team, get a one-page brief — what it would be here, the value beyond saved hours, what to build it with in the tenant, a two-day test. Good ones hand over to the Meeting Quarter.

journeys.q: I met stakeholders and must come back with a proposal
journeys.when: Someone described a problem to you in a meeting and now expects options, a recommendation and a deck they can decide on. Six stops, each ending in a gate where you check and approve. Takes an afternoon the first time.

stops.say: Start an engagement of kind 'proposal'. Drop the transcript and your notes in the folder it opens.
Copilot writes the fact base with a citation on every row. You check the three it flags. Gate G1 — never skip it.
Two or three solution options; you choose one (G2). Then the proposal with two storylines; you pick how it is told (G3).
The deck in the corporate template, built from your storyline. Open it before anyone else (G4).
Timed speaker notes, and the critic who lists what will not survive the room. Rehearse out loud.
After presenting: brief the team, turn their meeting into tasks, review them, then the tracker (G5).

journeys.q: I know the content, I need a deck
journeys.when: No decision to make, no options to compare — the message is clear and you need corporate slides plus something to say. Four stops.

stops.say: Start an engagement of kind 'deck'. Put your notes, documents or a draft deck in the folder.
Copilot extracts the key messages and facts (/content), cited. You check them — gate G1.
Two storylines from the content (/storylines); you pick one (G3).
Outline, then the .pptx. Open it (G4). Speaker notes live next door at the Theatre.

journeys.q: I just want a record of a meeting and my actions
journeys.when: A meeting happened, you owe nobody a deck, but you want a clean one-page write-up and your actions captured before you forget. Two stops, ten minutes.

stops.say: Start an engagement of kind 'meeting' with the transcript and your notes.
One page of notes cited to the transcript plus your actions as tasks. Review them, then they go to the tracker (G5).

journeys.q: I live in Outlook and Teams — no VS Code
journeys.when: You want your mornings, meeting filing and email drafting handled inside Microsoft 365 with no local setup. Build the stops in this order; each one takes 10–45 minutes once, then runs by itself or on one click.

stops.say: A scheduled prompt that writes your morning brief every weekday. Proves scheduled prompts work in your tenant.
A flow that files every meeting transcript into a SharePoint folder and a OneNote page, automatically.
An evening prompt that prepares tomorrow's meetings from what was filed.
An agent you ask for a same-day summary, a 1-1 prep, or what is still open.
An agent that turns rough text into a ready-to-send email in your voice.
A flow that pings you when tomorrow's 1-1 has no agenda.

journeys.q: Which Copilot model should I use for my work?
journeys.when: You wonder whether the expensive model is worth it, or which one is best at your kind of task. One stop; an afternoon once, ten minutes per new model afterwards.

stops.say: Collect tasks that failed you, run them on each model, grade with your own pass/fail checks, look at the side-by-side.

journeys.q: I saw an AI idea — would it work for us?
journeys.when: A demo, a newsletter or a vendor pitch made you think 'what would that be for my team?'. One conversation with a shared agent; if the answer is promising, it hands over to the proposal journey.

stops.say: Describe the idea and your team; get a one-page brief with value, build-with and a two-day test.
If the brief says 'continue', the idea enters the Meeting Quarter as a proposal engagement.

journeys.q: I am setting this up on my machine (technical)
journeys.when: Once, before the Meeting Quarter works on your computer: Copilot builds the deck scripts against your corporate template. About two hours.

stops.say: Open the folder in VS Code, run the bootstrap prompts, calibrate the corporate look, write your voice file.
Rebuild this map whenever a feature is added.
